items.item: Playground, The Robot Frontier Is Accelerating
items.outcome: planned: Reports row 14, RPT-013 (op-002); findings mapped in phase 3
items.classification: external robotics research report under the existing Reports rules: a capability index with conditional projections, not a market forecast; index odds, simulation results, real-robot results and conditional projections are kept apart

findings_draft.phrase: Since September they have doubled about every five weeks
findings_draft.statement: On the publisher's index, the odds of beating pi0 doubled about every five months for two years and about every five weeks since September 2026.
findings_draft.limits: Publisher's own index; odds, not raw scores.

findings_draft.phrase: have increased more than 9x in the past 3 months
findings_draft.statement: Relative capabilities on the index rose more than 9x in the three months to November 2026, against 2.4x from August 2025 to August 2026.
findings_draft.limits: Odds ratio of the index leaders; the page meta description gives 2.5 times instead.

findings_draft.denominator: tasks of the five benchmarks tracked since January 2025, equal weight (two simulation, three real robot)
findings_draft.locator: §Most real-robot tasks are not solved; Figure 6
findings_draft.phrase: rose from 25% to 43% in three months, after a year spent climbing from just 17% to 25%

findings_draft.denominator: average over the three real-robot benchmarks of the five
findings_draft.locator: §Most real-robot tasks are not solved; Figure 6
findings_draft.phrase: On the three real-robot benchmarks the share has held at 31% since January.
findings_draft.statement: The jump came on the two simulation benchmarks (15% to 61%); the three real-robot benchmarks held at 31% since January.

findings_draft.denominator: 138 real-robot tasks across the index's benchmarks, 2026-11-23 (simulation: 65% of 175 tasks)
findings_draft.locator: §Most real-robot tasks are not solved; Table 2
findings_draft.phrase: On real robots, the best policy on each benchmark scores at least 80% on just 32% of 138 tasks.
findings_draft.limits: A different measure from the 31% five-benchmark average; 80% is a low bar for real work (the page).

findings_draft.locator: lede; §What this means for capability projections
findings_draft.phrase: fully finishes one in ten of the hardest tasks, at about 30 minutes and $115
findings_draft.limits: Model-token cost at list price (Robocurve); Table 3 gives $119 per completed precision task and $41 across all tasks for the same system.

findings_draft.phrase: If the pace since September holds, it would complete over 90% of all three.
findings_draft.statement: If the two-year pace continues, by the end of 2027 the top system would complete about 86% of pick-and-place, 29% of precision and 25% of long-horizon real-robot tasks; if the pace since September holds, over 90% of all three.
findings_draft.limits: Conditional; the publisher calls the projections uncertain and its ranges exclude uncertainty about the pace; time and cost per attempt held fixed; 100/97/93% appear only in image alt text.

not_mapped: 104 to 1 and 100/97/93%: image alt text only (the body says about 100 to 1 and over 90%)
Precision odds rose 21-fold: no stated baseline (kept in the master cell, not drawn)
Meta description '2.5 times': differs from the body (9x and 2.4x)
